title.suggested: Tom Allen to Go to New Orleans with Frank Slavin for the Maher-Fitzsimmons Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, ex-champion of America, would leave St. Louis for New Orleans with Frank Slavin to see the Maher-Fitzsimmons and Ryan-Needham fights. Allen picked Ryan and favored Maher.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Sunday, February 28, 1892, page 24.

facts.fact: Allen was to leave St. Louis for New Orleans with Frank Slavin to see the Maher-Fitzsimmons fight at the Olympic Club

notes: Allen is mentioned in two sentences of a long fight preview. Departure 'to-morrow night' from a Sunday paper; a later paragraph says Slavin and Allen would 'probably' leave 'to-night', so the date is approximate. Allen and Tom Kelly thought Ryan would beat Needham and preferred Maher to Fitzsimmons.
